card.fires_on: The word 'a' or 'of' right after 'is' or 'one' when a condition or class is being introduced, just before a word like 'family', 'group' or 'series'. Also fires partway through names of drug classes, genes and part numbers.

modes.label: Introducing a group
modes.description: 'a' or 'of' after 'is' or 'creates' that leads into a family or group of conditions or chemicals.

modes.label: Inside class or gene names
modes.description: Partway through a drug, gene or product name that belongs to a family or series.
modes.example: Bexarotene is a member of the retin<<oid>> class of drugs that is associated with birth

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with 'family' or 'series' and similar words, in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It fires where the text is about to say that something belongs to a family, group or series.
